lines: Thus indeed in establishment in Khecarī-cakra which form shines forth; that very mudrā to be regarded, the rest would be bodily modification.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadevaṃ khecarīcakrarūḍhau yadrūpamullaset tadeva mudrā mantavyā śeṣaḥ syāddehavikriyā
